## What was built

**`src/config/env.ts`** — REG-FR-06 environment assembly:
- `parseSecretsFile()` parses `KEY=VALUE` lines with blank lines, full-line comments, inline comments on unquoted values, literal single-quoted values, double-quoted values with `\n`/`\r`/`\t`/escaped quotes, CRLF, and UTF-8 BOM. Duplicate keys keep the last value.
- `mergeEnvironment()` applies the inline `[env]` table first and the secrets file second, so file values win.
- `loadEnvironment()` reads the default `<app>/secrets.env` when present, or the app-relative `env_file` from `config.toml`. A declared-but-missing file is a usage error (exit 1); an unreadable file is a prerequisite error (exit 2). A second lexical containment check rejects paths escaping the app directory.
- `redactEnvironment()` and `ContainerEnvironment.redacted` expose a diagnostics-safe name → `[redacted]` view.
- Parse errors carry the file and line only — never the value. The unreadable-file path records only the errno code, since a lower-level error message could quote file content.

**`tests/unit/config-env.test.ts`** — 30 tests covering comments, blank lines, quotes, escapes, duplicates, invalid names with line numbers, missing declared file, traversal, unreadable file, merge precedence, config.toml integration, and redaction in text/JSON error paths.

## Contract notes

- New stable error codes: `INVALID_ENV_FILE` (exit 1) and `SECRETS_FILE_MISSING` (exit 1). Unreadable secrets reuse the existing `SECRETS_UNREADABLE` code (exit 2).
- Default behavior assumption: when `env_file` is absent, `<app>/secrets.env` is still read if present (optional); `env_file` selects an alternate app-relative file and makes its absence a usage error.
- No changes to exit-code values, JSON schemas, config keys, or file modes.

handoff.summary: Implemented REG-FR-06 environment assembly in src/config/env.ts with secrets-file parsing, inline merge where file wins, line-only invalid-name errors, missing-declared-file usage errors, and a redacted diagnostics view; 30 focused tests and all typecheck/lint/full-suite/build checks pass.
decisions: When env_file is absent, the default <app>/secrets.env is read if present but remains optional; a declared env_file that is missing is a usage error (exit 1).
Parsing supports full-line comments, inline comments on unquoted values, single-quoted literals, double-quoted escapes, CRLF, BOM, and last-value-wins duplicate keys.
Unreadable files report only the errno code, not the lower-level message, so a custom reader cannot leak file content.
A lexical containment re-check in loadEnvironment rejects env_file paths escaping the app directory even if the schema was bypassed.
interfaces: EnvironmentFileError { file, line, exitCode 1, code INVALID_ENV_FILE }
warnings: New stable codes INVALID_ENV_FILE and SECRETS_FILE_MISSING (both exit 1); unreadable secrets reuse SECRETS_UNREADABLE (exit 2), so docs should list the new codes.
ContainerEnvironment.values contains secret material by design; callers must pass it only to the container runtime and use .redacted for any diagnostics.
